items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Willie Joseph, his brother was one called Nelson Joseph. My brother on bass, I was on drum.

ctx.x: Good Lord man, he's worn out, you know. Well Matt, he needs to stop for a week or two at least. Let me see. Now who was in that young tuxedo when you and your brother started? We got Willie Joseph.

Willie Joseph, his brother was one called Nelson Joseph. My brother on bass, I was on drum. And let me see who was playing trombone. I forgot who was playing trombone. We had a 7th grade officer, you know that.
